prompt: What is a ChangeListener used for?
choices: Listening for changes in a JTextField
Listening for changes in a component's model state (e.g., JSlider value, JTabbedPane selected tab)
Listening for property changes on any object
explanation: ChangeListener (javax.swing.event) has one method: stateChanged(ChangeEvent e). JSlider fires it when the value changes. JTabbedPane fires it when the selected tab changes. Use slider.addChangeListener(e -> updateDisplay(slider.getValue())).
